user_hypothesis.statement_ru: В реверсивной модели некоторые египетские божественные ипостаси могли быть помещены в погребальный режим ожидания до восстановления Осириса.
user_hypothesis.research_translation: Search for cases where an animal was treated as an individual sacred manifestation, ritually preserved, buried by priests, explicitly bound to a deity by inscription/title, and connected to renewal/return rites.

core_distinction.reason: Egyptian evidence supports cultic embodiment, manifestation, ba/image language and sacred-animal burial; the stronger waiting-for-Osiris claim requires an explicit text or ritual sequence.

KV50_51_52_ANIMAL_TOMBS.location: Valley of the Kings near KV35, tomb of Amenhotep II
KV50_51_52_ANIMAL_TOMBS.discovered: 1906 by Edward R. Ayrton for Theodore M. Davis
KV50_51_52_ANIMAL_TOMBS.modern_scientific_anchor: Five mummified Papio hamadryas from KV50/KV51/KV52 are used as New Kingdom comparative specimens in modern biomolecular work; proximity permits association with Amenhotep II or Horemheb, but ownership/function is not securely established.

reported_ritual_objects: stucco mask from a canopic/intestine package
KV51.why_interesting: Baboon and ibis are both well-attested animal forms associated with Thoth.
why_not_closed: KV51 is a mixed faunal assemblage rather than an exclusively ibis+baboon deposit.
No Thoth name, Djehuty inscription, scribal palette, lunar emblem or explicit cult title was verified in this pass.
Modern scholarship has questioned the simple royal-pet-cemetery interpretation, but does not establish KV51 as a tomb of Thoth.

facts: Thoth was represented at Saqqara by baboons.
The baboons were comparatively few temple animals, not the mass votive category typical of ibises/cats/dogs.
They had been kept in captivity in a temple context and their burial was the responsibility of priests.
The Baboon Catacomb contained roughly 169-180 monkey individuals in modern archaeological estimates.
NORTH_SAQQARA_THOTH_CONTROL.reverse_use: This is the strongest current control showing that an animal associated with a deity could pass through a bounded temple-life -> priestly-burial -> preserved-body chain.

reverse_only_tranception_application.backward_question: If divine manifestations were intended to remain available across a long interruption, what material and ritual infrastructure would need to exist before C?
reverse_only_tranception_application.left_channel: THOTH: North Saqqara baboon catacomb -> KV51 baboon+ibis candidate
reverse_only_tranception_application.right_channel: BASTET: inscribed cat mummy containers -> Bubastis/Saqqara cult contexts
reverse_only_tranception_application.forward_replay_requirement: An ancient text or ritual must independently connect preserved divine manifestation to waiting, awakening, return, or restoration in relation to Osiris before the waiting-for-Osiris hypothesis can advance.
